resources.string: Tap a value from the message, or select text yourself and confirm. Skip fields that are absent. The amount is required. Mark other variable values as ignored so they do not become fixed text in the pattern.

Select the account number only if it appears in the message. Otherwise, choose “Not in this message”. You will choose your account for this movement when approving the financial interpretation; its number does not need to appear in the message. Do not use the transaction reference as an account number.
Saving the pattern alone did not post this message. Approve its financial interpretation, then apply it to eligible messages. Conflicts and missing facts remain in review.
Unknown format; not posted as a transaction.
Choose the transaction type for this message and save. Masroof uses the available facts; this action does not create a new message pattern or guess missing amounts or accounts.
The message was not posted. It may not match, may be protected by an earlier decision, or may still need review.
Preview is read-only. Applying is a separate action and excludes posted transactions, corrections and manual decisions. Pattern conflicts are never resolved by guessing.
From settings: choose a bank and paste an example. From review: the message and sender are prefilled and the original text stays unchanged.
